introduction: New York SNAP helps eligible households buy food through EBT. Application routes differ between New York City and other counties.
description: New York SNAP helps eligible households buy food through EBT. Application routes differ between New York City and other counties.

sections.who: Household income and circumstances affect eligibility. Most households do not face a savings-resource test, but the district must review the case.
sections.get: Monthly food assistance depends on the household budget. Qualifying urgent cases can receive expedited benefits.
sections.docs:
• Income evidence.
  • Rent or mortgage and utility information.
  • Requested identity and household records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the local route

    Outside NYC use myBenefits or paper intake; NYC uses ACCESS HRA.

  2. Explain urgent needs

    Ask for expedited screening when food and money are very limited.

  3. Complete verification

    Follow interview and document instructions.
sections.after: Read reporting and recertification notices. Do not use old income tables as current figures.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State SNAP application guidance. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
